subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 4: Language practice – I haven't got … + Sounds c, k, ck
outcomes: I can say I've got a book. I haven't got a crayon.
I can name all eight school things.
I can say the sound /k/ for c, k and ck and read cat, cap, sack, tick.

tf.s: I haven't got a book means I have no book.
tf.why: Yes! Haven't got means you don't have it.

tf.s: I've got a pen means I have no pen.
tf.why: I've got a pen means you have a pen.

tf.s: Our song is called I'm ready for school.
tf.why: Yes! We sing I'm ready for school.
Yes! The letter c says /k/ in cat.

tf.s: Duck ends with the letters ck.
Kite starts with the letter h.
A pencil case is a family word.
tf.why: A pencil case is a school thing.

tf.s: Thumbs down means I've got it.
tf.why: Thumbs down means I haven't got it.

boxes.q: Thumbs up + book: I … a book.
boxes.why: Thumbs up: I've got a book.

boxes.q: Thumbs down + crayon: I … a crayon.
boxes.why: Thumbs down: I haven't got a crayon.

boxes.q: The k picture on the Phonics Card is a …

boxes.why: c, k and ck all say /k/.
A pencil is a school thing.

hunt.q: Catch the /k/ word that starts with k.
Catch the /k/ word in the sky.
Catch the word that ends in ck.
Catch another word that ends in ck.
Catch the words that mean: no book.
Catch the school thing we read.
Catch the school thing for colouring.

mcq.q: Which of these words starts with /k/?
Which one means you have NO crayon?
mcq.why: Haven't got means you don't have it.

mcq.q: How many school things did we learn in Unit 2?
mcq.why: pen, eraser, ruler, bag, crayon, pencil case, pencil, book.

mcq.q: Which letters say /k/ at the end of duck?
You've got a ruler but no crayons. You say …
o: I've got a ruler. I haven't got crayons.
mcq.why: Say what you have and what you don't have.

mcq.q: Your teacher shows thumbs down and a pencil card. You say …
Cat, kite, duck. What sound do they all have?
mcq.why: c, k and ck all say /k/.

mcq.q: Which word does NOT have the sound /k/?
Which word does not belong: pencil, book, crayon, king?
mcq.why: King is not a school thing.
